name: Protect Kaya
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Kaya Flathoof is held captive among hostile Grimtotem tauren. Horde adventurers guide her along dangerous trails to Camp Aparaje, then tell her anxious father, Makaba Flathoof, that she survived.

sections.title: A Captive in the Crags
sections.body: Kaya Flathoof was captured deep in Grimtotem territory in the Stonetalon Mountains. The tauren clans are divided by bitter rivalries, and few face sharper hostility than the Grimtotem. Kaya has escaped captivity, but friendly ground lies beyond trails watched by enemies and predators. An armed escort gives her the best hope of getting through.

sections.title: Flight to Camp Aparaje
sections.body: Kaya aims for Camp Aparaje in the eastern Stonetalon Mountains. From there, she knows the way home and can continue on her own. You guide her along paths where ambushes threaten, helping her avoid recapture on the way to safety.

sections.title: A Father's Relief
sections.body: Makaba Flathoof waits near Stonetalon's southeastern border, fearing the worst for his missing daughter. Runners bring word that Kaya reached Camp Aparaje safely. Makaba's despair gives way to gratitude for the champions who stood between his child and her captors.

faq.answer: Kaya Flathoof is a young tauren captured by hostile Grimtotem forces in the Stonetalon Mountains. She depends on passing Horde adventurers to help her escape and reach safe ground.

faq.q: Where does Kaya need to be escorted?
faq.answer: Kaya needs an escort along the trails to Camp Aparaje in eastern Stonetalon. She aims for the camp, where she knows her way home.
Makaba Flathoof is Kaya's father, waiting anxiously near the southeastern entrance to the Stonetalon Mountains. He fears for his missing child until adventurers bring word that she has been rescued.
Hostile Grimtotem tauren captured Kaya. Their camps and ambushes lie across the crags of Stonetalon.

faq.q: What happens after Kaya reaches Camp Aparaje?
faq.answer: Once Kaya reaches Camp Aparaje, she can find her own way home. You then return to Makaba Flathoof with the joyful news that she survived.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Alliance players?
faq.answer: No. The Flathoof family are peaceful tauren aligned with the Horde, so only Horde adventurers can help with this rescue.

angles.text: As a tauren, you help one of your own caught in the Grimtotem clan's aggression.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep traveling families safe and strengthen the Horde's footholds and supply routes in Stonetalon.
